name: English (US) — starter pack
comment: This is a deliberately small hand-authored list, authored for this repository and released
under CC0, so iteration 001 can measure detection behaviour without shipping a third-party
word list whose licence has not been verified.
The full permissively licensed pack is still to be sourced — see the iteration 001 drift log.
FR-008a requires that every shipped pack declares its source and licence, and that a pack
whose provenance cannot be established does not ship. This pack's provenance is this file.
